title: The High Compass
author: Wendell Ravensworth
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the dry season ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
